_doc: STT leakage contract: load + branch transmitters (no stores).
status: v1 2026-11-02 (criteria-from-code session): encodes exactly what check_ld / check_br / check_other + gem5_common decide today; no checker reads this file yet (see wiki/design/TRANSMISSION_CRITERIA_FORMAT.md, 2026-11-02 section).
encoded_from: The per_kind / window / gates blocks are descriptive: the run is decided by the per-kind checker chosen in pipeline.py:_checker_for, which does not read this JSON.

window._doc: Shared by check_ld / check_br / check_other; each computes it on its own signal tick S (per-kind 'signal' below). All ticks from one gem5 run of one test.

speculative.text: (lc_retire == 0 ∨ S > lc_retire) ∧ (fnc_retire == 0 ∨ S < fnc_retire) ∧ S > 0 ∧ branches_unresolved(S). lc/fnc ticks = pipeview retire of best_record at the annotated lc/fnc PC (gem5_common.py:739-754: highest stage reached, latest retire). fnc_retire == 0 (fnc squashed) → no upper bound; no lc annotated → no lower bound.

branches_unresolved.text: every annotated unresolved branch other than the xmit (excluded at gem5_common.py:1125) is still unresolved at S. observed (binary has BR resolve hooks): resolve_tick = resolve_visible else resolve_release of the youngest held/visible, not-dropped dynamic instance (_resolution_of, :925-937); ok ⇔ resolve_tick == 0 (dropped / never resolved / never fetched) ∨ S < resolve_tick. estimate (older binary, no BR lines): prop_tick = pipeview complete + resolve_stall_cycles × ticks_per_cycle; ok ⇔ complete == 0 ∨ S < prop_tick.

gates._doc: Applied to every test regardless of kind, in gem5_common.process_one (STAGE3_gem5/gem5_common.py:1083-1209) and in each checker.

lc_retired.text: disqualify if an lc PC is annotated but its pipeview retire is 0: issued_in_window = False, criteria.lc_retired = False

checks.resolved_correct: no correctly_not_taken branch mispredicted on a retired instance
checks.window_opened: the oldest (lowest Alloy pc) non-xmit unresolved branch mispredicted on a retired instance
checks.stall_applied: every stalled unresolved branch that resolved has a resolve_hold
checks.force_applied: every planned BTB force got a predict_force of the right direction; force plan consistent with the flags idiom

execution_validity.text: each is True/False, or None when it does not apply or the binary has no BR resolve hooks. Any False → status = 'invalid', issued_in_window = False, the checker's verdict kept in issued_in_window_unvalidated, error = notes.

resolved_before_signal.text: reported only, NOT gated: every correctly_not_taken branch visible-resolved before S. Kept out of criteria.

status.ok: checker ran; issued_in_window is the verdict
status.warn: no xmit x86 PC resolved; gem5 not run (gem5_common.py:1112-1114)
status.error: build / gem5 / parse failure (gem5_common.py:1184-1200); see divide_fault for the one promoted case

gates.verdict: issued_in_window == AND of the non-None values in criteria (each checker's criteria dict + the four validity keys)

signal.text: S = latest LSQ 'Executing load PC (0x<xmit>' tick over all records at xmit_pc (_xmit_execute_tick, check_ld.py:30-36); if none, S = pipeview complete of best_record(xmit_pc) (check_ld.py:85-87).
signal.trace: LSQUnit debug lines parsed by gem5_common.parse_lsq (STAGE3_gem5/gem5_common.py:575-718)

reached_cache.text: some executed LSQ record at xmit_pc has packet_tick > 0 ('successfully sent out packet(s) for inst [sn:N]')

store_forward.text: fate executed_no_packet ∧ xmit pipeview complete > 0 (value forwarded from a store in the LSQ; never touches cache). Relabelled from executed_no_packet at check_ld.py:138-141.

spec_read_only.text: executed, no packet, spec_read_tick > 0 ('send a spec read for inst [sn:N]'): invisible spec read

executed_no_packet.text: executed, no packet, no spec read, xmit never completed in pipeview: delay-unit bounce (defense held)

never_executed.text: LSQ records at xmit_pc exist but none has execute_tick > 0

data_obtained.squash: load_squash_tick is reported only; squash timing never gates
data_obtained.applies_when: in_window ∧ xmit_execute > 0 ∧ fate is not None (LSQ records exist at xmit_pc). Otherwise ungated: issued_in_window = in_window (never hide a possible leak on a build without LSQUnit logging).

leak.text: issued_in_window ⇔ lc_retired ∧ S > 0 ∧ after_lc ∧ before_fnc ∧ branches_unresolved ∧ (gate applies ⇒ fate ∈ {reached_cache, store_forward})

signal.text: commit_traced = squash_by_pc non-empty (any 'Squashing due to branch mispred PC:' line in the run; Commit flag is always added, gem5_common.py:370-376). If commit_traced: S = earliest Commit mispredict-squash tick at xmit_pc (0 if it never redirected). Else: S = xmit pipeview complete.

branch_redirected.text: commit_traced: S > 0 ∧ (no fall-through record ∨ fall-through retire == 0). Else: fall-through and xmit records exist ∧ xmit complete > 0 ∧ fall-through retire == 0. Fall-through = smallest traced PC > xmit_pc (check_br.py:39-45).

leak.text: issued_in_window ⇔ lc_retired ∧ branch_redirected ∧ S > 0 ∧ after_lc ∧ before_fnc ∧ branches_unresolved
issued_in_window ⇔ lc_retired ∧ S > 0 ∧ after_lc ∧ before_fnc ∧ branches_unresolved

divide_fault.text: a gem5 'panic: fault (Divide-Error)' whose faulting PC is the xmit div (Alloy pc) and the xmit sits after the lowest mispredict branch pc is promoted from status 'error' to status 'ok', issued_in_window = True, hit_kind = 'div_fault'. Only for kind other_x.

known_issues.text: The data-obtained fate is not tied to the window. _xmit_cache_fate looks at every LSQ record at xmit_pc (any dynamic instance) and takes the earliest packet_tick / spec_read_tick, and store_forward uses pipeview complete > 0 at any time; none of these ticks is compared with lc_retire, fnc_retire or branch resolution. The window is checked on S (the LATEST 'Executing load' tick), so the in-window instance and the instance that obtained data need not be the same, and the packet may fall outside the window.

commit_traced is bool(squash_by_pc), i.e. whether ANY branch broadcast a mispredict squash in the run, not whether the Commit trace was enabled. A run with no squash at all falls back to the legacy pipeview-complete signal, which a delay defense (branch completes but never redirects) can false-positive.
A transmitter kind with no entry in _KIND_TO_CHECKER (ld, br_x, other_x) is checked by check_ld.py (_DEFAULT_CHECKER).

On a binary without the 2026-10-30 BR resolve hooks, branch resolution is an estimate (complete + stall × ticks/cycle, valid only if gem5 registered the stall) and all four execution_validity checks are None (not gated).

Applies only to the stt_on_recon unit (this file on gem5-recon-modded), not to /work/stt, which prints the packet line. On the Recon builds, reached_cache can never fire: parse_lsq sets packet_tick only from 'successfully sent out packet(s) for inst [sn:N]', which those builds do not print (their send line is 'Memory request (pkt: …) from inst [sn:N] was sent', lsq_unit.cc:1546). Every executed xmit load is executed_no_packet, so it counts only if pipeview complete > 0 (labelled store_forward). A load that sent a real read packet and was squashed before completing is scored NOT a leak, and kept leaks are mislabelled store_forward. Checker bug, not a gem5 bug. Proposed additive parse_lsq regex not applied (needs Anna).
